_comment: power-guard policy (XACA-1394, EPIC-0067 D4). Copy to ~/.aiteamforge/power-guard-policy.json on a UPS-attached machine.
_safety: Ships DISARMED: enabled false, dry_run true. Set dry_run false only after the supervised unplug drill (XACA-1395). Missing, unparseable or invalid policy => NO_ACTION, never a default threshold.

_fields.enabled: Must be exactly true for any verdict other than NO_ACTION. Default false.
_fields.dry_run: true => worst verdict is WOULD_SHUTDOWN (logged, never acted on). Only an explicit false allows SHUTDOWN. Default true.
_fields.min_percent: Shut down when battery percent is BELOW this (0-100). null/absent => this criterion never triggers.
_fields.min_minutes: Shut down when minutes_remaining is BELOW this (>= 0). null/absent => this criterion never triggers.
_fields.freshness_s: REQUIRED, (0, 3600]. Both receivedAt and the accessory's observedAt must be at most this old. Keep it a few reporter intervals (reporting.interval, default 60s).
_fields.consecutive: REQUIRED, integer 1-100. Number of DISTINCT readings (new seq/observedAt) in a row that must qualify.
_fields.accessory_ids: Optional list of accessory ids to watch. Omit to watch every accessory in the state file.
